title: Relative affine isomorphisms and finite unit conditions descend to an etale stage
statement: Let R,H be commutative rings and iota:R→H an ind-etale ring homomorphism. Let p:Y→Spec R and q:Z→Spec R be affine and locally of finite presentation. Fix finitely many elements a(k) of R whose images in H are units. If Y×_R Spec H and Z×_R Spec H are isomorphic over Spec H, there are a commutative ring S, ring homomorphisms phi:R→S and psi:S→H with psi∘phi=iota, Spec(phi) etale, all phi(a(k)) units, and Y×_R Spec S≅Z×_R Spec S over Spec S. No chosen point or polynomial chart is involved.

proof.text: Use RingHom.IndEtale.iff_exists to present H as a filtered colimit of etale R-algebras. Put w=product a(k). Since its image is a unit, the map R→H extends to R[1/w]. Factor this finitely presented algebra map through one stage using the cited finite-presentation factorization lemma. The image of w is a unit there, hence every a(k) is a unit there by IsUnit.prod_univ_iff. This is the fully proved private helper finite_units_stage.

Apply Spec to the ring colimit cocone to obtain a limit cone of affine schemes. At the unit stage take the base changes of p and q. They are affine and locally finitely presented, hence qcqs. Their two pullback squares have a common limit model after transporting the second square through the given isomorphism.

Apply the proved source-library AlgebraicGeometry.exists_iso_of_isPullback, the isomorphism assembly of the morphism and equality descent clauses of thm-pd-spreading-out. At its later stage use canonical pullback maps; the cone identities show their composites with the limit maps are the old maps. The resulting isomorphism commutes with the second projections. Naturality carries the unit conditions to the later stage, while the ring cocone compatibility gives psi.comp phi=iota and the original etale-stage property gives Spec(phi) etale.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_fp_iso_descend_indEtale
    (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (ι : R →+* H) (hι : ι.IndEtale)
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec R) (q : Z ⟶ Spec R)
    (hp : IsAffineHom p ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation p)
    (hq : IsAffineHom q ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation q)
    (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → R) (ha : ∀ k, IsUnit (ι (a k)))
    (hiso : ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) ≅
        pullback q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)),
      γ.hom ≫ pullback.snd q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι)) =
        pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ι))) :
    ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : S →+* H),
      ψ.comp φ = ι ∧ Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ∧
      (∀ k, IsUnit (φ (a k))) ∧
      ∃ γ : pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ≅
          pullback q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)),
        γ.hom ≫ pullback.snd q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) =
          pullback.snd p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
